classes.description: Generic class for app REST connection for an app provided by the TypeScript API

instance_methods.name: constructor
instance_methods.signature: constructor(string name, string description, string url, hash<auto> attributes = {}, hash<auto> options = {})
instance_methods.description:
Creates the object creates the TypeScriptAppRestConnection object

See `ConnectionProvider::AbstractConnection::constructor()` for `attributes` and `options` reference.

params.name: name
params.description: the name of the connection

params.name: description
params.description: connection description

params.name: url
params.description: the URL for the connection

params.name: attributes
params.description: various attributes. See below

params.name: options
params.description: connection options

instance_methods.name: constructor
instance_methods.description: creates the TypeScriptAppRestConnection object

params.name: config
params.description: with the following keys: - name (required string): the connection name - display_name (optional string): the display name - short_desc (optional string): a short description in plain text - desc (optional string): a long description with markdown formatting - url (required string): the connection URL - opts (optional hash): connection options - logger (optional LoggerInterface object): logger for the connection

params.name: attr
params.description: optional connection attributes - monitor (optional bool): should the connection be monitored? Default: True - enabled (optional bool): is the connection enabled? Default: True - locked (optional bool): is the connection locked? Default: False - debug_data (optional bool): debug data? Default: False - tags (optional hash): tags for the connection; no default value

throws.name: CONNECTION-OPTION-ERROR
throws.description: missing or invalid connection option or attribute
